verdict.rationale: Annual compliance filing is a fair question for a company-formation platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows the product filing recurring annual reports or franchise/annual taxes. The documented items are one-off post-incorporation tasks: ELSTER tax registration, trade registration, and the Transparenzregister entry. A 'Compliance API' is mentioned for Enterprise plans, but its scope is never described, so it cannot be credited as a recurring annual-filing capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can file annual reports and franchise tax on time through the platform
